commits.author: Hassan Ibrahem
commits.message:
docs: add AgDR-0001 for the JWT secret rotation (#44)

- Decision: rotate the leaked auth.secretKey, replace literal with
  ${AUTH_SECRET_KEY}, do NOT rewrite git history
- Rationale: 5-month public exposure means the value is already in
  GH public-data, BigQuery mirrors, third-party clones; history
  rewrite is theatre against that threat. Rotation closes the actual
  exposure in 3 minutes.
- Captures the full incident timeline, the rejected alternatives,
  and the persistent ruleset changes made to unblock the merge

Closes TechMentors-LLC/charity_hub#32

commits.author: hassanibrahim
commits.message:
Refactor event handlers and services to remove CompletableFuture usage

- Updated ContributionRemindedHandler to handle events synchronously.
- Refactored GetLedgerHandler and GetLedgerSummaryHandler to return results directly instead of CompletableFuture.
- Modified INotificationService and its implementation to use synchronous methods.
- Changed AccountsGateway and CasesGateway to return results directly instead of CompletableFuture.
- Simplified AccountCreatedHandler to handle events synchronously.
- Refactored MembersNetworkRepo to remove CompletableFuture from methods.
- Updated NotificationService to use synchronous methods for notifications.
- Removed unnecessary CompletableFuture usage in CommandHandler and QueryHandler interfaces.
- Cleaned up tests to reflect changes in method signatures and behavior.

commits.author: hassanibrahim
commits.message:
Refactor controllers and handlers to remove DeferredResult usage

- Updated DeleteDraftCaseController, GetAllCasesController, GetCaseController, GetDraftCasesController, PayContributionController, and UpdateCaseController to return ResponseEntity directly instead of using DeferredResult.
- Modified command handlers (ContributeHandler, CreateCaseHandler, DeleteDraftCaseHandler, PayContributionHandler, UpdateCaseHandler) to handle commands synchronously instead of returning CompletableFuture.
- Introduced ICaseReadRepo interface for read operations and implemented it in CaseReadRepo.
- Updated query handlers (GetAllCasesHandler, GetCaseHandler, GetDraftCasesHandler) to use the new ICaseReadRepo interface.
- Added temporary methods for synchronous operations in repositories and updated existing methods to use them.
- Adjusted the CasesAPI to use the new ICaseReadRepo for fetching contributions and cases.

commits.author: hassanibrahim
commits.message:
feat: Refactor account and invitation repositories to include temporary methods for fetching and saving data

- Added temporary methods in IAccountRepo and IInvitationRepo for fetching accounts and invitations by ID and mobile number.
- Implemented temporary save methods in both repositories to allow for immediate data persistence.
- Updated GetConnectionsHandler to use the new IAccountReadRepo for synchronous fetching of connections.
- Refactored controllers to return ResponseEntity directly instead of using DeferredResult for better clarity and performance.
- Introduced new CommandHandlerTemp and QueryHandlerTemp abstractions for handling commands and queries without CompletableFuture.
- Updated application properties to support environment variable-based MongoDB credentials and enhanced management configurations.
